question: Which of the following folk dances is conducted during the Bwisagu Festival?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Bagurumba**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Bwisagu Festival** is a prominent festival celebrated by the **Bodo community** of Assam, marking the arrival of the **New Year**.
 
• The **Bagurumba** is a traditional folk dance performed during this festival and is often called the **"Butterfly Dance"** because of its graceful, rhythmic movements resembling the fluttering of butterflies.
 
• It is primarily performed by **Bodo women** wearing traditional attire like the **Dokhona, Aronai, and Jwmgra**, which are vibrant and colorful.
 
• This dance symbolizes **harmony with nature**, as it reflects natural elements like birds, animals, rivers, and forests.
 
• Musical instruments such as the **Serja, Sifung (flute), and Kham (drum)** often accompany the performance, creating a lively and culturally rich atmosphere.
 
• The Bagurumba dance is not just a celebration but also a way to preserve and promote the **cultural identity** of the Bodo community.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bhortal**__

 __
 
• **Bhortal** is a traditional folk dance of **Assam**, performed by groups of dancers using **cymbals**.
 
• It is an energetic dance form created by the renowned Assamese artist **Narayan Chandra Goswami**.
 
• The dance is often associated with **Sattriya culture** and involves intricate rhythms and synchronized movements.
 
 
 
• **Jhumur**__
 __
 
• **Jhumur** is a traditional dance form performed by the **tea tribes** of Assam, West Bengal, and Jharkhand.
 
• This dance is characterized by **simple steps** and is performed during festivals and celebrations among the tea garden workers.
 
 
 
• **Bihu Dance**__
 
 
• The **Bihu Dance** is one of the most popular and celebrated dance forms of **Assam**, associated with the **Rongali Bihu** festival.
 
• It is performed by both men and women and is known for its **vibrant movements and traditional music**.
 
• The dance signifies **fertility, love, and joy**.
